issues.question: May petitioner claim Child No. 2 as a dependent for 2021?
issues.holding: No; child did not share petitioner's abode for more than half the year, and no §152(e) release was signed and attached

issues.question: Is petitioner entitled to the child tax credit for Child No. 2 for 2021?

decision.text: Decision will be entered under Rule 155.
